finding: propertyDeclaration accepts invalid Property Let/Set forms with AS clause or zero params
resolution: Split into propertyGetDeclaration / propertyLetDeclaration / propertySetDeclaration. Get keeps optional params + AS; Let/Set require parameterList and have no AS.

finding: parameterList over-permissive on ParamArray and default-value combinations
resolution: Split parameter into requiredParameter / optionalParameter / paramArrayParameter. Default value moved to optionalParameter only. paramArrayParameter requires LPAREN RPAREN and rejects modifier combinations. ParamArray restricted to trailing position.

finding: WithEvents declarations could parse As New T per H-F01 violation
resolution: moduleVariableDeclItem split into WithEventsVarItem (uses typeName, requires AS, no NEW, no array, no STAR) and RegularVarItem (full typeSpec).

finding: publicEventDeclaration accepted Private modifier; not valid VBA syntax
resolution: Modifier reduced to PUBLIC?. Test Event_PrivateModifier removed; replaced by Reject_PrivateEvent negative test.

finding: Module test suite was acceptance-only; no negative tests for over-acceptance bugs
resolution: Added 11 negative tests under the Reject_* prefix covering all R1-1..R1-4 fixes plus default-without-Optional and ParamArray-not-last positional.

finding: parameterList still accepted required parameter after Optional
resolution: Replaced parameterEntry mixed list with positionalParameters: required* then optional*, OR optional+. Added Reject_RequiredAfterOptional negative test.

finding: publicEventDeclaration reused parameterList which accepts Optional/ParamArray, illegal on event params
resolution: Introduced eventParameterList / eventParameter restricted to required-only (no Optional, no ParamArray, no default). Added Reject_EventOptionalParameter and Reject_EventParamArrayParameter negative tests.

finding: Negative test suite did not exercise adjacent shapes (PropertySet no-params, ByRef ParamArray, ParamArray default, WithEvents array, WithEvents fixed-length-string, Friend Event)
resolution: Added Reject_PropertySet_NoParams, Reject_ByRefParamArrayCombination, Reject_ParamArray_DefaultValue, Reject_WithEvents_ArrayDeclarator, Reject_WithEvents_FixedLengthString, Reject_FriendEvent.
